text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about five hours a week. CRM updates stopped being a Friday-night chore.

2. Notes got more consistent. Every call now captured next steps, objections, and decision-makers, not just what the rep remembered.

3. Managers coached from real conversations instead of rep summaries. That changed our one-on-ones.

4. Adoption wasn't automatic. Reps worried about being recorded, so we explained exactly who sees what. Trust came before usage.

5. Accuracy slipped in noisy sites and with heavy jargon. A quick review habit fixed most of it.

The tool didn't make anyone sell better. It gave them time and clarity to do it themselves.

What would you want from a pilot like this?
